Markets.title: Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks rise as investors await Trump-Xi meeting
Markets.summary: China and Hong Kong stocks rose on Monday, led by gains in technology, healthcare, and property shares. Investors were awaiting a planned summit between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping to extend their trade truce, following high-level talks in New York.

Markets.title: HEG shares rally 5% after receiving Rs 217.56 crore order from Indus Towers for lithium-ion battery banks
Markets.summary: HEG shares rose 5 percent after its subsidiary, Replus Engitech, secured a Rs 217.56 crore order from Indus Towers for lithium-ion battery banks. The order is scheduled for completion by March 31, 2027.

Markets.title: RIL selloff wipes off Rs 4 lakh crore from market value as shares drop 21% in 2026 so far. Should you buy now?
Markets.summary: Reliance Industries shares have dropped 21% in 2026, wiping out Rs 4 lakh crore in market value. Analysts advise investors to avoid buying the dip due to windfall tax issues and uncertainty surrounding a Jio listing.

Markets.title: Sensex jumps 400 points, Nifty nears 23,400 as oil prices cool down despite Middle East tensions. What lies ahead?
Markets.summary: Indian equities rose in early trade, driven by lower crude prices that offset ongoing Middle East tensions. Analysts expect market volatility to continue due to geopolitical risks, high yields, and sectoral shifts.

Markets.title: US economy enters higher-rate era as inflation, AI boom persist
Markets.summary: Persistent inflation, government borrowing, and AI investments are driving up the demand for capital in the US. Consequently, the economy is entering a prolonged period of higher interest rates and elevated long-term borrowing costs.

Markets.title: JSW Cement shares gain 2% after Motilal Oswal upgrades stock to Buy. Check target price
Markets.summary: JSW Cement shares rose nearly 2% after Motilal Oswal upgraded the stock from Neutral to Buy. The brokerage cited strong volume growth, expansion in North India, cost efficiencies, and a positive medium-term outlook.

Geo-Political.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
Geo-Political.summary: German Chancellor Merz described recent state election results as a disaster after his centre-right CDU party suffered heavy losses in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Despite these damaging exits polls, Merz vowed to remain in his position.

Geo-Political.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow, involving hundreds of aerial vehicles overnight. Moscow's mayor reported that air defenses downed 450 drones during the barrage, which resulted in two deaths.

Geo-Political.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
Geo-Political.summary: Ed Sheeran addressed his "mistakes" during his first concert since rapper Macklemore was removed from his tour lineup. Macklemore had been dropped following controversial pro-Palestinian remarks he made on stage regarding the Israel-Gaza conflict.

Geo-Political.title: Sister of Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan arrested
Geo-Political.summary: Aleema Khanum, the sister of former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan, has been arrested. She is accused of mobilizing her brother's supporters in preparation for nationwide protests.

Data & Insights.summary: India's Income Tax Department is using overseas units to explain new tax laws to foreign entities. These units provide clarity on cross-border taxation, transfer pricing, tax treaties, and investment rules.

Data & Insights.title: Govt plans  ₹10,000-crore push to modernise India’s weather forecasting
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian finance ministry is reviewing a ₹10,000-crore proposal from the ministry of earth sciences to modernize weather forecasting. The initiative aims to strengthen prediction models and establish a robust early-warning system across the country.

Data & Insights.title: China drives India’s BRICS export surge to $19.9 billion; shipments to Japan, Italy, S Korea also gain
Data & Insights.summary: India's exports to BRICS nations surged 34% from April to August 2026, led by a 39% increase in shipments to China. During the same period, exports to Japan rose 43% due to higher demand for energy products and electronics.

Data & Insights.title: Why does India need to save more?
Data & Insights.summary: India needs a higher savings rate to sustain its 7-8% economic growth. This increased savings is necessary to fund ongoing investments in infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, technology, housing, and human capital.

Data & Insights.title: Saudi Arabia exits mBridge: Can China-led platform still challenge US dollar, become global cross-border payment system?
Data & Insights.summary: Saudi Arabia quietly exited the China-led mBridge digital currency project in 2025 as originally planned. Despite this withdrawal, the platform continues to expand its efforts to enable faster cross-border payments and reduce reliance on the US dollar and SWIFT.

Data & Insights.title: Food prices stable as pulses, cereals output rises; sugar rates ease
Data & Insights.summary: Pulses production rose to a record 27.4 million tonnes and cereals output increased by about 5% to 349.1 million tonnes in 2025-26. This higher agricultural output helped stabilize food prices and ease sugar rates.

India.title: Bank Strike September 28-30: SBI Issues Advisory, Check Services That Will Remain Available
India.summary: State Bank of India issued an advisory regarding a bank strike scheduled for September 28-30. The bank is taking steps to ensure essential banking services remain available during this period.

India.title: Cockroach Joins Cardiologist For Dinner At JW Marriott, He Tags Tukaram Munde

India.title: CSEET Admit Card 2026 Release Date: Check Steps To Download, Exam Date

General.summary: Survivors of the Oxford child sexual exploitation ring told the BBC that hundreds of their abusers remain free. These underage girls stated that the men who abused them are still walking around the city.

General.title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns
General.summary: The National Association of Head Teachers in England is calling for a halt to graded Ofsted inspections. The union argues that the current inspection process poses a serious risk to the health and lives of school leaders.

General.summary: A Canadian minister told the BBC that the UK should partner with Canada in a new European alliance. This follows a proposal by the European Commission President to consider Canada as an associate member of the EU.

General.title: Young people aren't snowflakes - mental distress is rising, says head of official review
General.summary: An official review head states that being young is much harder today than in the past. He adds that rising mental distress among youth proves they are not snowflakes.
